I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random. I confirmed the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. I also told them I don't keep records between conversations, so their earlier post in #central-team won't be corrected by telling me. If people rely on that post, they should edit it or post the fix there.

That was the only action I took. I didn't read #central-team or change anything else. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so repeating it in the channel was fine.
